source: wago.tools DB2 wowf 1.60.1.70790 with hotfixes, plus the Forever client hotfix cache (build 70862, 5,071 records)

talents.name: Convection
ranks: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, and Chain Lightning spells by 2%.

talents.name: Concussion
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Earth Shock spells by 1%.

talents.name: Earth's Grasp
ranks: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 25% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 10%.

talents.name: Elemental Warding
ranks: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 4%.

talents.name: Call of Flame
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and by your Flame Shock and Fire Nova spells by 15%, as well as increases the duration of your Flame Shock spell by 9 sec.

talents.name: Elemental Focus
ranks: Gives you a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state after casting any Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell. The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next damage spell by 100%.

talents.name: Reverberation
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by 0.2 sec.

talents.name: Call of Thunder
ranks: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 5%.

talents.name: Trial by Fire
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 20% and reduces its cooldown by 2 sec, and increases the duration of your Magma Totem by 20 sec.

talents.name: Eye of the Storm
ranks: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Elemental Devastation
ranks: Your Critical Strikes with direct damage spells increase your chance to get a Critical Strike with melee attacks by 0% for 10 sec.

talents.name: Elemental Reach
ranks: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Fire Nova spells by 6 yards.

talents.name: Elemental Fury
ranks: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

talents.name: Elemental Alacrity
ranks: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 0.2 sec.
Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 0.4 sec.
Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 0.6 sec.
Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 0.8 sec.
Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 1 sec.

talents.name: Lightning Mastery
ranks: Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Ancestral Knowledge
ranks: Increases your Intellect by 10%.

talents.name: Shield Specialization
ranks: Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 1% and increases the amount blocked by 5%.
Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 2% and increases the amount blocked by 10%.
Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 3% and increases the amount blocked by 15%.
Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 4% and increases the amount blocked by 20%.
Increases your chance to block attacks with a shield by 5% and increases the amount blocked by 25%.

talents.name: Guardian Totems
ranks: Increases the amount of damage reduced by your Stoneskin Totem and Windwall Totem by 10% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 1 sec.

talents.name: Thundering Strikes
ranks: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%.

talents.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
ranks: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

talents.name: Improved Lightning Shield
ranks: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 5%.

talents.name: Enhancing Totems
ranks: Increases the effect of your Strength of Earth and Grace of Air Totems by 8%.
Increases the effect of your Strength of Earth and Grace of Air Totems by 15%.

talents.name: Two-Handed Axes and Maces
ranks: Allows you to use Two-Handed Axes and Two-Handed Maces.

talents.name: Anticipation
ranks: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 1%.

talents.name: Flurry
ranks: Increases your attack speed by 1% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

talents.name: Toughness
ranks: Increases your Stamina by 2%.

talents.name: Improved Weapon Totems
ranks: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Windfury Totem by 15% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Totem by 6%.
Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Windfury Totem by 30% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Totem by 12%.

talents.name: Elemental Weapons
ranks: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 7%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 13% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 5%.

talents.name: Spirit Weapons
ranks: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

talents.name: Weapon Mastery
ranks: Increases the damage you deal with all weapons by 2%.
Increases the damage you deal with all weapons by 4%.
Increases the damage you deal with all weapons by 6%.
Increases the damage you deal with all weapons by 8%.
Increases the damage you deal with all weapons by 10%.

talents.name: Stormstrike
ranks: Instantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Improved Healing Wave
ranks: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.1 sec.

talents.name: Tidal Focus
ranks: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Reincarnation
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by 10 min, increases your maximum health by 4%, and increases the amount of health and Mana you reincarnate with by an additional 10%.

talents.name: Ancestral Healing
ranks: Increases your target's armor value by 0% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

talents.name: Totemic Focus
ranks: Reduces the Mana cost of your totems and any spells that summon or move them by 5%.

talents.name: Nature's Guidance
ranks: Improves your chance to hit by 1%.
Improves your chance to hit by 2%.
Improves your chance to hit by 3%.

talents.name: Healing Focus
ranks: Gives your healing spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Totemic Mastery
ranks: The radius of your totems that affect friendly targets is increased to 30 yd.

talents.name: Natural Grace
ranks: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30%.
Reduces the threat generated by your healing spells by 10%.
Reduces the threat generated by your healing spells by 15%.

talents.name: Restorative Totems
ranks: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 5% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 5%.

talents.name: Tidal Mastery
ranks: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 1%.

talents.name: Healing Way
ranks: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 33%.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
ranks: When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Purification
ranks: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 10%.

talents.name: Mana Tide Totem
ranks: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.
